title: Suite-wide code is copied into each tool, not loaded from one shared place
context: 24-f13-shade.js carries the F13LD-SHADE / F13LD-VIEW blocks byte-identical with other F13LD tools (CLAUDE.md); 02-materials.js is generated from F13LD.lab by tools/sync-materials.js. By contrast the F13LD.queue client is loaded at runtime (43-handoff.js loadQueueClient).

options.name: Copy per tool, kept identical by convention (current)
options.summary: Each tool works standalone; sync by hand or script.
pros: A tool can pin a known-good copy
cons: Every fix has to be repeated in each tool
Drift is only caught if someone compares

options.name: Load shared blocks from one URL
options.summary: Serve shade, view and materials from a suite origin, as the queue client already is.
cons: A broken shared file breaks every tool at once

options.name: Sync script for every shared block
options.summary: Generalize tools/sync-materials.js to shade/view, with a byte-compare check.
pros: Keeps standalone tools, removes hand copying
cons: Still a manual step per tool

recommendation: CLAUDE.md requires 24-f13-shade.js to stay byte-identical with the other tools and 02-materials.js to be regenerated from Lab.
strain: The "◐ view" glyph in the shared F13LD-VIEW block breaks the no-glyph rule; Synth patches it after init and NEXT-UP says the real fix has to go into every tool.
